description:
## Current delivery contract — user-approved two-outcome stack
Owner: PR A. One PR per complete outcome, NOT one PR per bead. Keep detailed beads and cohesive internal commits for tracking; consolidate existing draft foundations into their owning feature PR where practical. PR B stacks on independently usable PR A. Include owning PR documentation and validation there. This supersedes earlier per-bead/prerequisite PR instructions and historical comments. Closed foundation status is not outcome acceptance.
New-feature E2E requires explicit human UX approval in zaq-emb.12; no self-approval.

After coverage and review follow-up, run mix precommit through Context Mode with 900000ms timeout against final changes. Fix failures and repeat required checks; failed-test-only rerun does not replace a clean full gate. Record migration, E2E, coverage and independent review evidence. Ask final human approval only on clean gate. Do not commit/push/close automatically. Action reuse not applicable: validation coordination. Files: no production scope; follow-up defects tracked by owner. Tests: full final gate plus isolated regression checks as needed. Documentation: Beadwork validation summary.

Execution requirements: planning only until assigned for implementation. Preserve existing uncommitted work and progress comments; do not infer completion from historical tests. Read AGENTS.md, docs/agent-tools.md, docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md, docs/action-reuse.md, docs/testing-approach.md and applicable service guides before affected work. Write immediate unit/integration/property regression tests BEFORE implementation. Mock only genuine external boundaries; keep internal domain paths real. Run isolated tests and mix q per issue; final precommit belongs to the dedicated final gate. New feature E2E authoring waits for zaq-emb.12. No commit/push authorization is implied.
title: [zaq-emb.20] Final precommit and implementation approval gate
